title: Eye Rest
intro: A quiet moment away from the screen. Skip any step that does not suit you.

steps.text: Look away from the screen and find something far from you, ideally about six metres away.
Rest your gaze there. Let it be soft, with no need to focus hard.
Blink slowly a few times, at an easy pace.
Close your eyes if you like and let them rest in the dark.
Look at something close, then something far, once or twice, at your own speed.

closing: Eyes rested for a moment. Back to it whenever you are ready.
